title: Gia Lai in a day
summary: Two-bowl phở, then Biển Hồ and Buu Minh on the northern loop, Minh Thanh above town, and Dong Xanh on Quốc lộ 19.

stops.name: Two-bowl pho
stops.note: The two bowls on Nguyễn Văn Trỗi, from early morning.

stops.name: Biển Hồ
stops.note: The crater lake about 7 km north, in the first light.

approach.note: Taxi or ride-hail about 7 km north, off Phạm Văn Đồng onto Tôn Đức Thắng.

stops.name: Buu Minh Pagoda
stops.note: The hall in the tea hills of Nghĩa Hưng, about 15 km or more than 15 km north.

approach.note: Taxi or ride-hail north into the tea hills, about 15 km or more than 15 km.

stops.name: Minh Thanh Pagoda
stops.note: The gold-painted tower on the hill above Pleiku.

approach.note: A short taxi from central Pleiku.

stops.name: Dong Xanh Park
stops.note: The culture park in An Phú, about 10 km along Quốc lộ 19.

approach.note: Taxi or ride-hail about 10 km along Quốc lộ 19 to An Phú.

additions.name: Tay Son Thuong Dao
additions.note: The forest cluster at An Khê.

additions.name: K50
additions.note: The cliff fall in Kon Chư Răng, from the reserve office more than 140 km from Pleiku.

seoTitle: Gia Lai in a day — Biển Hồ and the pagodas
seoDescription: One day in Pleiku: two-bowl phở, Biển Hồ, Buu Minh, Minh Thanh, and Dong Xanh on Quốc lộ 19.
